Chapter 37
Arjuna). Añjāna (collyrium) Kadara¹ (white catchu) Aśoka, Tiniśa² and red sandal.
शिरीषसर्जन्यग्रोधवेणवः कीलकर्मणि।
पुन्नामानो द्रुमाः शस्ताः स्त्रीनामानो विगर्हिताः ॥३॥
441
Śirīşa, Sarja, Nyagrodha (Indian Fig tree or Vata) (Banyan tree) and Venu (bamboo or
cane or ratton) in the work of pegs the masculine named tees are excellent and the feminine
named are abhorable.
अश्वत्थः खदिरश्चैतौ विप्राणां वृद्धिकारकौ।
रक्तचन्दनवेणूत्थकीलौ क्षत्रस्य पूजितौ ।।४।।
The Banyan and Catchu are salubrious for the buildings of the Brahmanas and the pegs
carved out of red sandal and bamboo are adored for the Kşatriyas.
शाकश्च खदिस्श्वेति सामन्तानां हिताविमौ ।
कीलौ शालशिरीषोत्यौ वैश्यानां कीर्तितौ शुभौ ।।५।।
The teak wood tree and the catechu these two are salubrious for the Samantas houses
(i.e. subsidiary vassals houses).
The pegs raised out of Śāla and Śirīşa are deemed as
auspicious for the (houses) of Vaiśyas.
शूद्रजातेस्तु तिनिशधवार्जुनसमुद्भवाः।
वैश्यवेश्मसु सौभाग्यकार्ये च स्युरशोकजाः ।॥६॥
For the (houses) of Śūdra caste, those born of Tiniśa, Bhava and Arjuna (are useful).
Those carved out of Aśoka are the harbingers of fortune in the houses of Vaiśyas.
न्यग्रोधो वणिजां धाम्नि भूमिकर्मण्युदुम्बरः ।
महामात्र (त्रा) श्ववैद्यानां कीलाः सर्जार्जुना गृहे ।।७।।
Nyagrodha or Vața (i.e. Banyan) tree in the abode of the merchants or grocers, (is
useful).
In the house of Mahāmātras (elephant drivers or chief functionaries of the state)
and the physicians of horses, Sarja and Arjuna (trees) are useful for pegs.
विप्राणां सर्ववर्णोत्थाः क्षत्रियाणां त्रिवर्णजाः।
वर्णद्वयोक्ता वैश्यानां शूद्राणां स्वानुलोमतः ।॥८॥
For the houses of Brahmaņas (the pegs) carved out for all the castes, for those of
Kşatriyas those carved out for three castes and for those of the Vaiśyas those ordained for
1. खदिरे स्याद्रक्तसारः कण्टकी दन्तधावनः। गायत्री बालपत्रश्च जिहशल्य क्षितिदुमः सिते तु तत्र कदरः कामुकः कुब्जकण्टकः ।
सोमवल्को नेमि वृक्षः श्यामसारः पथिदुमाः। Nighantuśeșa, 1.64-65, p. 37 of Hemacandra.
2. तिनिशे चित्रकृद् नेमि र्वजुलो रथसाधकः । Nighantuseșa 1.89, p. 51.
3. IASITBSOVM, p. 286.

442
Samarangaņa-sūtradhāra
the two castes and for those of the Südras, as per right order caste arrangement.
प्रतिलोमा न कर्तव्याः कीलका भूतिमिच्छता।
प्रमाणान्यथ कीलानां निगद्यन्ते पृथक् पृथक् ।।९।।
The left order castes' system the pegs deserve not to be created by one desiring
affluence.
Now the measurements of the pegs in due said order are being explained.
द्वात्रिंशदङ्गुलाः कीला विप्राणां स्युः शुभावहाः।
क्षत्रियाणां पुनश्चाष्टाविंशतयङ्गुसम्मिताः ।।१०।।
For the houses of Brahmaņas thirty two Angulas i.e. 24 inches in size pegs may be
ordainer of wellbeing and for the Kşatriyas however, twenty eight i.e. twenty one inches in
size the pegs stand ordained.
चतुर्विंशत्यङ्गुलाश्च वैश्यानां शुभदायिनः।
विंशत्याद्यङ्गुलैः कीलाः शूद्रजातेस्तु ते हिताः ।।११।।
For the houses of Vaiśyas the pegs of twenty four i.e. 18 inches in size are the endowers
of wellbeing.
For the houses of the Śūdra caste, by twenty Angulas i.e. fifteen inches in size
the pegs are ordained as beneficial.
षडङ्गुलपरीणाहाः सर्वेष्वेते शुभावहाः।
ब्राह्मणाक्षत्रियविशां वेदाष्टश्रषडश्रयः ।।१२।।
Those measuring six Angulas i.e. 4.5 inches in size the pegs are good for all, the
Brāhmaņas, Kşatriyas and Vaiśyas being octagonal or hexagonal in structure.
षडश्रयस्तु शुन्द्रस्य प्रकृतेस्तु यदृच्छया।
दार्भमौञ्जौर्णकार्पासं विप्रादीनां यथाक्रमम् ।।१३।।
Hexagonal are for the houses of Śūdra (caste) and as per wanton will for those having a
natural instinct.
Those made of Darbha, Muñja grass, woollen and cotton fabric normed are
ordained for the Brahmaņas and the like as per serial order.
अर्धपर्वपरीणाहं दृढं सूत्रं तु वर्तितम्।
अलाभे स्वस्य सूत्रस्य प्रोक्तादन्यतमं बुधः ।।१४।।
गृह्णीयात् सूत्रमन्ये तु गृह्णीयुः स्वेच्छयैव ते।
इत्थं संभृत्य सम्भारान् गृहभर्ता शुभेऽहनि ।।१५।।
A thread woven as such stout as such, having extent of a half coil, (one may acquire)
and on non-availability of this one, the wise one may acquire a thread different from one
talked of (above) and others may get the thread as per wanton will.
This way having
gathered the materials the land Lord on an auspicious day.

Chapter 37
443
शुक्लपक्षे शुचिः स्नातः स्थपतिश्च सिताम्वरः ।
गृहस्थाननिमित्तात् तु देवस्थानानि लक्षयेत् ।।१६।।
On a bright fortnight, bathed and gone pure, and the Architect white costumed
anticipating the evil omens may look for the householders and the abodes of gods i.e.
temples.
कुसुमाक्षतमय्यश्च कर्त्तव्या गृहदेवताः।
आदौ स्थानानि शकूनां परीक्षेत समन्ततः ।।१७।।
The house deities or tutelary deities deserve to be created made of flowers and unhusked
rice.
To begin with the points of spikes one may examine or locate all around.
तेषु सर्वेषु कर्त्तव्यमर्चनं तु यथाविधि।
गृहस्य मध्ये सिक्त्वा तु निरूप्य ब्रह्मणः पदे ।।१८।।
On all those deserves to be done the worship as per ritualistic norm. Having sprinkled in
the centre of the house, having well tested at the abode of Brahmā.
गोमयेन समालिप्तां कुर्याद् वेदीं सुलक्षणाम्।
चतुरश्रां चतुर्द्धारामक्षतैः सुप्रतिष्ठिताम्।।॥१९॥
One may create a raised platform or a balcony well plastered with cow-dung being of
good marks square normed, four gated, nicely sprayed over by unhusked rice.
तस्या मध्ये प्रतिष्ठाप्यः कुम्भो हैमोऽथ राजतः।
ताम्रको मृन्मयो वापि पूर्वालाभे परः परः॥२०॥
In the midst of that deserves to be assorted an ewer golden as well as of silver, a copper
made or even a clay moulded the one the succeeding one adjustable in case of non-
availability of the preceding one.
अकालमूलः सोऽव्यङ्गो जलपूर्णः स्वलङ्कृतः ।
मणिरत्नप्रवालैश्च स्वर्णरूप्येण गर्भितः ।।२१।।
The one not having a black bottom, undeformed, water filled, nicely embellished, by
gems, jewels and corals having inside gold and silver.
प्रतिष्ठाप्या (प्याऽ) क्षतैः पुष्पफलबीजसमन्वितः ।
श्वेतेन चन्दनेनैनं चर्चयित्वा समन्ततः ।॥२२॥
Deserves to be adjusted equipped with flowers and fruits and unhusked rice having
plastered it with white sandal all over.
तस्योपरिष्ठाद् विन्यस्येत् क्षीरवृक्षस्य पल्लवम्।
सुगन्धिनाथ धूपेन धूपयित्वा चतुर्दिशम्।॥२३॥

444
Samarängaņa-sūtradhara
Over that may be assorted a leaf of Milk tree having perfumed it with the scented
incense on all the sides.
वेष्टयेदहतेनैनं शुक्लवस्त्रेण सर्वतः ।
वास्तुमध्ये यतो ब्रह्मा कुम्भरूपं (पः) स तिष्ठति ।। २४।।
One may surround it or cover all over by a white spruce cloth because in the centre of
the house (it may look like) Brahma the ewer shaped one staying as such.
कुम्भस्योत्तरभागे तु कीलकान् स्थापयेद् बुधः।
कीलानष्टौ परीक्षेत स्थापयेच्च यथाविधि।। २५॥
The wise one may adjust nails on the northern part of the pitcher or reverse side of the
pitcher.
He may examine the 8 nails and may fix them in serial order or as per ordainment.
श्वेतचन्दनलिप्तांस्तान् श्वेतपुष्यैर्विभूषयेत्।
सालक्तकान् सुरभिणा धूपेन च सुधूपितान् ।।२६।॥
To them painted in white sandal he may adorn it with white flowers endowed with
lacquer dye perfumed nicely with scented incense.
ऊर्णामयेन सूत्रेण त्रिवर्णेनाभिवेष्टयेत्।
मधुसर्पिर्दधिक्षीरैर्मूलभागेषु लेपयेत्।। २७।।
With a thread made of wool, of three colours he may wind round all over and may make
them anointed at the root corners or bottom points with honey, ghee, curd and milk.
अर्चयेत् परशुं सूत्रमष्ठीलादीनि सर्वतः ।
अथोपकरणान्यत्र धूपपुष्पाक्षतादिभिः ।। २८ ।।
One may adore the axe, the thread and the round pebble or stone and the like. And
thereafter here, the materials with incense flowers and unhusked rice and the like.
ततः पूर्वोत्तरे वास्तोर्भागे सप्तर्चिषः पदे।
गोमयेन समालिप्ते कुशास्तरणमास्थितः ।। २९।।
Thereafter in the eastern northern part of the house, on the place of fire, well plastered
by cow-dung squatted on a Kuśā mat.
अग्निकार्यं प्रकुर्वीत पुरोधाः शान्तिमेव च।
सांवत्सरः शुचिः स्नातः कृतस्नानः (?) समाहितः ।॥३०॥
1. V.S. Apte, p. 67. अष्ठीला। MW. p. 117, a ball or globe
2. V.S. Ape, p. 584. सप्तर्चिः ।

Chapter 37
445
One may take to the sacrificial performance the chaplain or priest as also the
pacificatory rites (he may perform).
The astrologer, pure as such, bathed having ablution
performed, well concentrated.
शकुना साधयेल्लग्नं सम्यक् तद्धटिकाथवा (?)।
रात्रिलग्नं तु नक्षत्रैर्मध्यास्तोदयसंश्रितैः ।। ३ १।।
By a spike or the pin of a dial may accomplish the time of initiation or zodiac properly
and the watch hour of that, the zodiac of the night by stars based on setting and rising in the
middle or centre (of the Moon).
एवं संसाधयेल्लग्नं यदीच्छेत् सिद्धिमात्मनः।
पूजया तुष्टिकारिण्या पूजयेच्च पुरोहितम् ।।३२।।
This way one may get the zodiac ascertained in case he may cherish his own

Bondage and injury in spirit the rise of the enemy, the gain of a son and wealth and the

best.

On a spot wherein Brahma is to be installed, that very way should be done in case of
Vişņu.

By which subdivision of
which one, the measurement of the house or temple is calculated.
1. Matsya P. describes about pedestal in chapter 262.

तस्य तेनैव भागेन पीठोच्छायो विधीयते।
मनुजानां च पीठानि वेश्मनां देवपीठकैः ।।६।।
तुल्यानि कुर्यादुपरि कृता वृद्धिकराः सुराः।
पुरमध्ये तु कर्त्तव्यं ब्रह्मणो गृहमुत्तमम्।।७।।
Of that one by that very subdivision, is accomplished the measurement of the seat or
pedestal.
The pedestal of men's houses equal to those of the pedestals of gods one may
create.
The gods installed overhead are prosperity giving. The excellent temple of Brahma
should be created in the centre of the town.
चतुर्मुखं च तत् कार्यं यथा पश्यति तत् पुरम्।
अधिकं सर्ववेश्मभ्यस्तथा राजगृहादपि ।।८।।
The four faced one or the one having face in four directions that should be created or

orders of society we now talk of the pedestals in descending order.

हितं कारयितुर्वाञ्छन् नृपतेश्च समृद्धये ।।१३।।

and others has been illustrated the one being in entirety fit to be calculated on per suitability

Then a regnal calamity known as Brahma, declared as such becomes in vogue.
In case
contracted in the centre and vivacious in the exteriors.

# Chapter 44: The definition of an Architect

CHAPTER 44
The definition of an Architect¹
स्थापत्यमुच्यतेऽ स्माभिरिदानीं प्रक्रमागतम्।
ज्ञातेन येन ज्ञायन्ते स्थपतीनां गुणागुणाः ।।१।।
Now Architecture is being dilated upon by us, come upon as in due order (for
expatiation), by which one having been understood, the qualities and disqualification of the
architects stand located.
शास्त्रं कर्म तथा प्रज्ञा शीलं च क्रिययान्वितम्।
लक्ष्यलक्षणयुक्तार्थशास्त्रनिष्ठो नरो भवेत् ।।२।।
The treatise or scripture, the practical as pect practial science and its theory and practice
the intelligence and good conduct or honesty endowed with practicability, the target or the
motive and the specific marks equipped purpose, the person may become well groomed in
scientific lore.
सामुद्रं गणितं चैव ज्योतिषं छन्द एव च।
सिराज्ञानं तथा शिल्पं यन्त्रकर्मविधिस्तथा ।।३।।
Palmistry2 (a mark or spot on the body) and mathematics, Astrology and prosody the
knowledge of sirās (i.e. arteries, veins or nerves buckets or bailing vessels³ or lines which
cross each other like veins) and like the craft or mechanical art and the art of implementing
the working of mechanical contrivances.
एतान्यङ्गानि जानीयाद् वास्तुशास्त्रस्य बुद्धिमान्।
शास्त्रानुसारेणाभ्युद्य लक्षणानि च लक्षयेत्।।४।।
These components the wise one may know of the Science of Architecture.
Having
spoken as per theory of the theoretical treatise he may mark out the pre-requisites.
प्रसिद्धशास्त्रदृशन्तैर्वास्तुज्ञानं प्रसाधयेत्।
वास्तुनः ससिरावंशैर्मर्मवेधैः सुनिश्चितैः ।॥५॥
By the popular instances of the theoretical knowledge he may accomplish the
knowledge of the science of Architecture by the vein like corpuscles of the building and by
the obstruction of the vulnerable spots nicely determined.
1. This chapter is at No. 8 in Dr. D.N. Shukla's edition pp. 33-34. Text and pp. 35-36. Hindi
Translation.
2. V.S. Apte, p. 599. MW, p. 1206 a work on Palmistry by Durlabharājā.
3. V.S.Apte, p. 604.

वास्तुद्वारक्षणान् भूयः सर्वान् जानाति शास्त्रतः ।
यस्तु शास्त्रमविज्ञाय प्रयोक्ता स्थपतिर्भवेत् ।। ६ ।।
He who knows in absolute theory all the happy aspects of the openings of the buildings
in amplitude or substantiation, (he may be belauded) and he who takes to practising without
having understood the theoretical works and may assume the office of an Architect.
हन्तव्यः स स्वयं राज्ञा मृत्युवद् राजहिंसकः।
मिथ्याज्ञानादहङ्कारी शास्त्रे चैवाकृतश्रमः ।।७।।
He deserves to be killed by the king himself the one killer or murderer of the Royal
status being a death in corporal form being a murderer of the king.
Owing to manipulated
or pretentious or fake knowledge having labour not undertaken in the theoretical norm of
the literary treatise or scientific text.
अकालमृत्युर्लोकस्य विचरेद् वसुधातले ।
यस्तु केवलशास्त्रज्ञः कर्मस्वपरिनिष्ठितः ।।८।।
May haunt along the untimely death on the surface of the soil and he who may alone be
an expert in the theoretical norm, and is not a skilled one or well trained in practical aspect.
स मुह्यति क्रियाकाले दृष्ट्वा भीरुरिवाहवम्।
केवलं कर्म यो वेत्ति शास्त्रार्थं नाधिगच्छति ।।९।।
He faints at the time of practical observances like a coward fainting on seeing the
battlefield.
And one who is alone expert in practical aspect and fails to assimilate the sense
of the theoretical treatise.
सोऽचक्षुरिव नीयेत विवशोऽन्येन वर्त्मसु।
कर्म वास्तुविधेः स्थानं मानमुन्मानमेव च।।१०।।
That one like an eyeless man, helpless as such may be led away to stray paths by another
one.
The work proper of the designing of a house, its plot, measurement and elevation or
size measure or price.
क्षेत्रजाति (नि) च कर्माणि लुमालेखाच (श्च) तुर्दश।
चत्वा (तु)रो गण्डिकाच्छेदान् वृत्तच्छेदेषु सप्तसु ।।११।।
The designing emanating from the area or plot and the linings of and carvings of
fourteen types, to four Ganddīkācchedas in seven circular holes (one may create).
सुश्लिष्टं सन्धिसन्धानैरधरोत्तरसंयुतम्।
बाह्यरेखान्वितं शुद्धं यो जानाति स कर्मवित्।।१२।।
Well knit by the plugging of joints, endowed with the adjustment of lower and upper

parts, he who understands the polished one having out a lining well adjusted or glued.
शास्त्रकर्मसमर्थोऽपि स्थपतिः प्रज्ञया विना।
फलेयुः कर्मभिरन्याभिः (?) स्यान्निर्मद इव द्विपः ।।१३।।
Even capable of taking to the task of theoretical aspect, an architect within the
application of mind, desirous of fruits by other norm of actions, may be one like a tusker
rutless as such.
प्रत्युत्पन्नमतिर्यः स्याद् वाहतः (कः) स्थपतिस्तथा।
कर्मकाले न मुह्येत् स प्रज्ञानेनोपबृंहितः ।।१४।।
That very way an Architect may be of a resourceful intellect as one taking to the task
skilfully.
At the time of practical work he may not get unnerved thoroughly impregnated by
knowledge.
अप्रज्ञेयं दुरालोकं गूढार्थ बहुविस्तरम्।
प्रज्ञापोतं समारुह्य प्राज्ञो वास्तुनिरं (?) तरेत् ।।१५।।
Fit not to be gauged difficult of visibility, having essence inscrutable, and highly
detailed one, having mounted on to the ship of intellect, the wise one may ferry across the

उपरथ्या त्रिहस्ता तु शेषास्तु द्विशयाः स्मृताः ।।४२।।
Having started from the Brahmasthana the house is remembered as having Five Śayas
(cubits) or having five beds.
The side lanes being of three cubits and remaining parts as of
two cubits or beds.
सन्निकृष्टा विधातव्या दुर्गा (र्ग) रथ्या समन्ततः ।
द्वारं रथ्याप्रमाणेन कार्यं नात्यन्तमुच्छ्रितम् ।।४३।।
Closely connected should be created the fort lanes all around.
The door or gate should
be created as per size of the lane and not much elevated.
परचक्रसमं (मसं) बाधं सुरक्षं तत् सदा भवेत्।
दुर्गेश्वरगृहस्थानं ब्रह्मणः परितो भवेत्।।४४।।
Having the blockade for the enemy forces and secure as such my it be.
The abode of the
commander of the fort may be such as having surroundings all over Brahma.
वैवस्वतेऽथवार्यम्णे मैत्रे पृथ्वीधरेप्रपि वा।
यथा पुरे पुरा प्रोक्तं स्थानं दुर्गेऽपि तत् तथा।।४५ ।।
In the Vaivasvata or in Aryaman in Maitra or Prthvidhara, the way it has been talked of
regarding the town or capital, in the fort also the abode of fort superintendent may be there.
वीराः शुभा ह्यदोषाश्च भूमिपालस्य संमताः ।
धनुर्वेदविधिज्ञाश्च कृतास्त्राः शास्त्रपारगाः ।।४६।।
The sentinels faithful and flawless of a king (the protector of the Earth, have been

दुर्गे स्थाप्याः सुरूपाश्च बहवश्च वरस्त्रियः।
अन्तःपुरं च कोशं च कुमारांश्चात्र वासयेत्।।४७।।
In the fort are to be stationed lovely formed and innumerable concubines and the harem

एवं दुर्गविधानस्य समासोऽयमुदाहृतः ।
इत्यष्टाङ्गो वास्तुशास्त्रस्य सारः संक्षेपेण स्पष्टमस्माभिरुक्तः ।
यत्र ज्ञाते शिल्पिवद् वास्तुविद्यापाथोनाथं सन्तरन्त्यप्रयासात्।।४८ ।।
This way succinctly has been illustrated the provision of a fort.
This way the eight
normed essence of the science of Architecture in brief has been dilated upon by us wherein
knowledge having been assumed, those endowed with the art ferry across the ocean in the
form of the Science of Architecture without any difficulty.
इति महाराजाधिराजश्रीभोजदेवविरचिते समराङ्गणसूत्रधारापरनाम्नि वास्तुशास्त्रे
अष्टाङ्गलक्षणं नाम पञ्चचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः ।

# Chapter 46: Toraņabhańgādi Śāntikaḥ

CHAPTER 46
Toraņabhańgādi Śāntikaḥ
The pacificatory Rite on the collapse of an arched portal.¹
पुरातनं नवं वापि कृतं वाथर्धनिर्मितम्।
देवतानां नृपाणां च तोरणं निपतेद् यदि ।।१।।
Older one or dilapidated one or a newly constructed one, or even one having been
created half way, the arched portal of gods or kings if may collapse.
भज्यते दह्यते वाथ नमते सज्जतेऽथवा ।
दवविद्युज्जलाद्यैर्वा हन्यते तत् कदाचन ।।२।।
Gets broken or burnt or even bends down or gets clung over or entangled or gets
trimmed² or is demolished or struck against by forest conflagration, lightning sometimes.
तत्र दोषान् प्रवक्ष्यामो दोषप्रशमनानि च।
तोरणं निपतेत् सर्वं शिरो वास्य कथञ्चन।॥३॥
Therein I shall illustrate the damages or defects as also their pacifications. The arched
portal way fall down fully or its top may collapse somehow.
राज्ञां सेनापतीनां च प्रतीहारपुरोधसाम्।
प्रधानाश्वगजानां च विप्रपौरजनस्य च।।४।।
1. Dr. D.N. Shukla's edition has it as chapter 37. Text pp. 180-183. Hindi Translation, pp. 183-185.
2. V.S. Apte, p. 577.

Of kings, army chiefs, door-keepers or chaplains of Pradhanas or chief functionaries of
state, of horses or elephants of Brahmaņas and citizen folk.
तत्र मृत्युभयं विद्याद् दुर्भिक्षं चापि निर्दिशेत्।
तस्मात् प्रशमहेत्वर्थं विधिं कुर्यादिमं बुधः ।।५।।
Therein a death danger one may presume and may even foresee a famine. On that
account for the sake of pacification the wise one may take to the ritual of this norm.
ऋत्विग्भिर्ब्रह्मणैर्धीरः स्थपतिः सपुरोहितैः।
रात्रौ होमबलिं कुर्यान्नगरे तु चतुर्दिशम् ।।६।।
By the Priests officiating at a sacrifice and Brahmaņas the valiant or Heroic architect

कर्णचत्वरशृङ्गाटेष्ववनीपालवेश्मनि।
स्थानेष्वेतेषु विप्राद्यैर्वेदि निष्पाद्य साक्षताम् ।।७।।
On the corners, squares quadrangles within the palace of the protector of the Earth i.e.
King on such spots by Brāhmaņas and others, having got erected a raised platform or
enclosed pavilion, (decked or sprayed over) by unhusked rice grains.
कलशैर्द्रव्यगन्यैश्च श्वेतमाल्याम्बरैर्वृताम्।
तत्र होमं प्रकुर्वीत शान्तिकं बलिमेव च।।८।।
With pitchers and with materials and scents or scented materials, screened all over by
white wreaths and cloths, there he may organise a sacrificial ritual as also an offering meant

एवं प्रशमयेत् सर्वं यत्किञ्चिद् दुरितोत्थितम्।
तोरणं भज्यते चेत् तद्राष्ट्रभङ्गं विनिर्दिशेत्।।९।।
This way he may pacify all that may be such as erupted from a sin or an evil omen.
In
case an arched portal gets broken or gets collapsed then the disintegration of the country he
may predict.
अस्य प्रशमहेत्वर्थं पूर्वोक्तं कारयेद् विधिम्।
तदेवैकं प्रदह्येत तोरणं नगरे र्य (य) दि।।१०।।
For the acquiescent of this fact, he may take to the ritual as closely suggested.
And that
very way in a town or a capital, if an arched portal may get incendiarised.
1. शृङ्गाटम् a place where 4 roads meet V.S. Apte, p. 561 or a triangular place MW, p. 1087.

तदा वह्निभयं ब्रूयाद् राष्ट्रस्य नगरस्य च।

Then dangers of fire one may pronounce for the country as well as for the capital.

नते वा शीर्णभग्ने वा व्याधिपीडां विनिर्दिशेत्।
होमं बलिं च कुर्वीत पुनः संस्कारमस्य च।।१२।।
(The arched portal) getting bent or broken or getting torn as under he may enjoin the

(He) may take to the task of sacrificial offering as well as sacrificial

वातेन विद्युता वापि तोरणं यदि भज्यते।

In case an arched portal gets collapsed or broken by breeze on squall or lightning, then

शान्तिकर्म प्रकुर्वीत ततः शान्तिकरं भवेत्।

The pacificatory rite he may organise that may create pacification. This way and the

पूर्वावयवनिर्माणाद् विशिष्टं रचयेत् पुनः।

From the construction of the first component, the main (component) he may recreate

Rich in handy work of varied norm, adjusted on a suitable spot and fascinating as such,

नियुक्ते तु पुनः शान्ति ब्राह्मणान् वाचयेत् ततः।

When erected as such, once again he may arrange the pacifictory rites from the
Brāhmaņas.
In case of the new one or old one or having been halfway.

प्रासादे वा गृहे वापि कपोतः प्रविशेद् यदि।
तत्र दोषाः प्रपद्यन्ते शान्तिकर्म तथैव च ।।१८।।
In a palace or a house if a pigeon may enter therein defects creep in and a pacificatory

कालमूर्तिः कपोतश्च पापमूलकरण्डकम्।

The pigeon is reckoned as a death in corporeal form and a casket having roots for sin or

चतुर्विधः समाख्यातो मुनिभिः स तपोधनैः।

By sages having richness for penance, that one has been predicted as of four types i.e.

कपोतो भवने यस्य श्वेतवर्णो विशेत् क्वचित्।

A pigeon in whose house, a white coloured one may enter sometimes then that one

Perennially ailments or maladies grow forth and trouble for children gets along. The

सर्वाः सिद्धीश्च कृष्णाङ्गः प्रदुष्य च कुलं हरेत्।

And a black hued one may wrest all the accomplishments and may wrest whole of the

बन्धनानि च जायन्ते प्रविष्टे तु कपोतके।

On a pigeon having entered, incarcerations become prominent. On that account having

स्नातस्त्रिकालशुद्धात्मा सोपवासो जितेन्द्रियः।

Bathed and having soul purified in the triad of times having fasting assumed, and

यवान्नप्रायभोजी च नित्यं होमपरायणः।
गुरुविप्ररतश्चैव श्वेतमाल्याम्बरस्तथा ।। २६ ।।
Having food merely as barley meal, perennially taking to the act of sacrificial offerings,

गृही सगृहिणीकस्तु व्रतमेतत् समाचरेत्।
श्वेतके पञ्चरात्रं च चित्रकण्ठे दशैव तत् ।।२७।।
The householder along with the housewife may take to such a vow (on the entry) of a
white (pigeon) for five nights and on that of a variegated necked for ten days.
चित्रे पञ्चदशाहानि कृष्णे दिवसविंशतिः ।
व्रतस्थेन तु कर्त्तव्यमग्निकार्यं मनोरमम् ।।२८।।
On the (entry) of a variegated one, for fifteen days and on that of a black one for twenty

यथालाभं समादाय तस्य देहं सपिच्छकम्।
निकृन्तेत् खण्डखण्डानि विभागाष्टशतानि तम्।। २९॥
Having brought, as per advantage the body of that one along with fledges he may chop
off piecemeal into eight hundred parts.
घृतप्लुतानि पुण्यानि मधुलाजान्वितानि च।
पञ्चवारुणसंज्ञेन वह्निकार्ये कृतेऽक्षतैः ।।३०।।
Suffused with ghee and sieved, equipped with honey and fried grains, the sacrificial
offering having been done with unhusked rice with the help of Pancavāruņa chant.
ततश्च मांसं जुहुयाद्धव्यमात्रेण मन्त्रवित्।
हुते क्रव्ये ततः क्षीरं दधिमध्वाज्यमेव च ॥३१॥
Then he may offer oblation of meat or flesh with simple ghee being a chanter of chants.
The carrion having been consumed subsequently, milk, curd and clarified butter he may
offer.
संपूजयेद् ग्रहान् सर्वान् ब्राह्मणान् वाचयेत् ततः।
स्ववित्तपादं श्वेते तु विप्रेभ्यः प्रतिपादयेत्॥३२॥.

He may adore all the malignant planets and may make the Brahmanas recite (sacred

वित्तार्धं चित्रकण्ठे तु पादोनं सर्वचित्रके।

Half of the property unto the variegated necked one and less by a quarter for the wholly

This way may ensue passivity in the house and bearing the obviation of all the

One attains to prosperity along with sons and grand sons having no end at all and

# Chapter 47: The pre-requisites of a Vedi

CHAPTER 47
The pre-requisites of a Vedi - An enclosed pavilion or a raised balcony or
balustradel or the space between the supposed spokes of a wheel shaped altar
or covered verandah or balcony in a courtyard (shaped like a Vedi and
prepared for weddings).
वेद्यश्चतस्त्रो विज्ञेया या पुरा ब्रह्मणोदिताः।
वयं ताः संप्रवक्ष्यामो नामसंस्थानमानतः ।।१।।
The Vedīs four as such may be recognised as illustrated earlier by Brahmā or for
Brāhmaņas.
We shall now illustrate those as per importance of station or standing and
nomenclature.
प्रथमा चतुरश्रा स्यात् सभद्रा च द्वितीयका।
तृतीया श्रीधरी नाम चतुर्थी पद्मिनी स्मृता ।।२।।
The first one may be square shaped and the other or second one as endowed with a
bhadra² or named as Sabhadra or endowed with an aisle.
The third one may be Śrīdharī or
having Lakṣmī installed within and the fourth one as Padmini or lotus normed.
यज्ञकाले तथोद्वाहे देवतास्थापनेषु च।
नीराजनेषु सर्वेषु वह्निहोमे च नित्यशः ॥३॥
At the time of sacrifice or marriage and during the installation of deities during
lustration ceremonies of all types and in the fire offerings of all norms invariably.
नृपाभिषेचने चैव शक्रध्वजनिवेशने।
नृपयोग्या भवन्त्येता वर्णानामनुपूर्वशः ॥४॥
During the installation to the throne ceremony of a king or consecration ceremony of a
king and during the incorporation of Indra's banner these become (assigned) as suitable for
the king as per descending order of orders of society or castes.
चतुरश्रा तु या वेदि नवहस्ता समन्ततः ।
अष्टहस्ता प्रमाणेन सर्वभद्रा प्रकीर्तिता।।५।।
The square shaped Vedī normally is allocated the size of nine cubits and the
Sarvabhadrā is required to be assumed the structure of eight cubits.
श्रीधरी सप्त विज्ञेया हस्तान् मानेन वेदिका।
षड्ढस्ता चैव शास्त्रज्ञैर्नलिनीह विधीयते ।।६।।
1. A quadrangular spot in the courtyard of a temple or palace. V.S. Apte, p.
533.
2. Partico or moulding, EOHA, p.407.

Śrīdharī is to be known as of seven cubits in measurement, being a Vedika and Nalint
or Padmini here is enjoined as having six cubits, by the experts in architecture.

The structure fracture wherein may ensue, on the rear or on the flanks the loss of
wealth and food grains therein becomes certain.
यत्र प्रत्यङ्मुखे शाले गृहं तत् स्याद् विकोकिलम्।
आयुश्चतुष्पदं धान्यं वसतां तत्र नश्यति ।। ३६।।
Wherein the two rooms face the west that house may be "Vikokila" of these living
within, the Age, quadrupeds and food grains meet their exhaustion.
सीमाशालाप्रभिन्नस्य प्रासादस्य गृहस्य च।
अस्थिरा जायते ऋद्धिः स्थितिश्च न भवेच्चिरम्।।३७।।
A house having cracks within the bordering rooms and of a palace the prosperity
becomes vacillating or fluctuating and the existence may be short lived.
सर्वदोषकरी ज्ञेया गर्भे चन्द्रावलोकिता।
मूषां विना विनाशाय कामोच्छित्त्यै गवाक्षकः ।॥३८।।
A creator of all damages or harms may be the (śālā) exposed to moonlight;
reft of air
holes or round windows may be a window deemed as meant for destruction and for the
truncation of physical enjoyments (Kāma).
यदा गण्डोऽथवा कुक्षिः पृष्ठं कक्षाथ भिद्यते।
दारिद्र्यं जायते भर्तुस्तदानीमदुस्सहम्।। ३९॥

When a ganda i.e. a tumoured portion or a cheek region or a flank, a middle or
abdominal region a rear portion or an armpit like portion or a side long area, gets cracked, a
collateral assumes a form for the owner or a co-sharer gets birth against the owner, that
very time, but not difficult of forbearance or penury or indigency creeps in for the owner
immediately as highly intolerable.
गर्भादुभयतो गण्डौ कक्षे स्तः कर्णभित्तिगे।
दक्षिणोत्तरयोः कुक्षी पृष्ठतः पृष्ठमादिशेत् ।।४०।।
On both the sides from the central part, the two tumours or eruptions and the two side
flanks may be such as gone within the wall of the corners and in south northern points, the
two Kukşis or hollows from the back of the rear stand as enjoined.
स्थापितद्वारसंरोधे गृहिणो जायतेऽश्मरी।
द्वारे तु विहिते तस्मिन्ननर्थस्तस्य जायते ।।४१।।
In case of an obstruction over the door carved out as such for the house owner,
strangury becomes (a disease) and a window created within that becomes meant for a
heinous catastrophe.
पूर्वद्वारनिरोधं तु नवमार्गं कदाचन (?)।
श्रोत्ररोधेऽश्मरीदोषः कृत्तश्रोत्रेह्यनम्यता (?) ।।४२।।
To a new passage having a hurdle within the eastern or primary gate the ear-deafness
and the strangury inflammation, the ear-dissection and insensate norm (are the outcome).
कृत्तानि यत्र चीयन्ते गवाक्षालोकनानि च।
तत्र प्रसूतिर्न भवेन्निष्पन्नापि विनश्यति ।।४३॥
Wherein the windows and ventilators are brick-lain truncated as such, therein progeny
may never come into being and even when accomplished gets into doom.
चीयमाना यदा भित्तिर्दक्षिणा स्याद् बहिर्मुखी।
तदा व्याधिभयं विद्यान्नृपदण्डभयं तथा।।४४।।
Being brick-lain when the wall south sided may be having opening outside then one
may predict the disease and danger and likewise the danger of Royal punishment.
यदा तु पश्चिमं कुड्यं प्रयाति बहिरग्रतः।
धनहानिं विजानीयाच्चौरेभ्यश्च भयं तदा ।।४५॥
And when a hinder wall or a Western Wall vends its way on to exterior in front, loss of
wealth and pilferage from thieves one may predict.
1. दारिद्र्यं जायते भर्तुः तदानीमदुस्सहम्। GOSE XXXVIII.39, pāda 3, p. 260.
2. Dr. D.N. Shukla's Text p. 186 verse 39 pāda 3-4 has दारिद्र्यं जायते भर्तुस्तदानीमतिदुस्सहम्।

उत्तरं तु यदा कुड्यं चीयमानं बहिर्द्रजेत्।
गृहभर्तुश्च कर्तुश्च व्यसनं स्यात् तदा महत्।।४६।।
The northern wall when being brick-lain if may bend outside, then to the landlord, may
lurk along amighty calamity as also for the builder or architect.
यदात्रं चीयमानायाः पूर्वभित्तेर्बहिर्द्रजेत्।
तदा गृहपतेस्तीव्र राजदण्डभयं भवेत्।।४७।।
When the frontal portion or top of the wall being brick-lain in the eastern direction, may
converge on the exterior, then one may predict for the Lord of the house a terrific Royal
Indictment.
प्राग्दक्षिणो यदा कर्णश्चीयमानो बहिर्द्रजेत्।
तत्राग्निभीतिरतुला संशयश्च प्रभोर्भवेत्।।४८॥
The east southern flank being brick-lain, when may converge outside, therein
incendiary danger and an uncomparable suspicion may creep in for the landlord.
बहिर्मुखो यदा गच्छेत् कर्णो दक्षिणपश्चिमः।
कलहोपद्रवस्तत्र स्याद् भार्यायाश्च संशयः ।॥४९॥
When the south-western flank¹ may open facing the exterior, the effervescence of
disputes may there be along with a suspicion or danger to the life.
यत्रोत्तरापरः कर्णश्चीयमानो व्रजेद् बहिः।
पुत्रवाहनभृत्यानां भवेत् तस्मिन्नुपद्रवः ।।५०।।
Wherein north-western flank when being brick-lain, may vend its way outside there
may be the calamity pending for sons, vehicles and servants.
यदा प्रागुत्तरः कर्णो बहिर्गच्छति वेश्मनः।
तदा गवां वृषाणां च गुरूणां च क्षयो भवेत्।।५ १।।
When the east-northern flank may vend way on the exterior of a building then for kine
and bulls and of elders, a demolition may ensue.
चतस्रो भित्तयो यस्य बहिर्निर्यान्ति वेश्मनः।
चीयमानास्तदत्रोक्तं मन्दिरं मल्लिकाकृति।।५२॥
The four walls of which building issue out on the exterior, when being brick-lain, that
house is termed as Mallika Krti having the shape of a Mallika i.e. a lamp-stand or an
1. D.N. Shukla edition p. 187 verse 49 has बहिर्मुखोयदा गच्छेत् कर्णोदक्षिणपश्चिमः । pādas 1-2.
2. V.S.Apte, page 428.

earthen vessel of a particular type.
तादृग् गृहे न तत्रायो व्ययो भवति यादृशः।
कर्शितोऽस्यैव दोषेण तस्य भर्त्ता पलायते ।।५ ३॥
In a house of that type, where income and expenditure may not be at par with each
other rendered indigent by the defection of that one, the landlord becomes fugitive or runs
away.
संक्षिप्यते तु यद् वेश्म चीयमानं समन्ततः।
संक्षिप्तमिति तज्ज्ञेयं तत्र राजभयं भवेत्।।५४।।
The house that gets encrouched while being brick lain, on all sides, "Sańkşipta" this
way that may be known.
Therein there may be the danger of Royal (punishment).
यत् स्यादन्तेषु संक्षिप्तं विस्तृतं चापि मध्यतः ।
मृदङ्गाकृतिसंस्थानं तत्र व्याधिभयं भवेत्।।५५।।
That may be suppressed or compressed or encrouched on the corners and wider at the
central parts, the one being an Institution of having shape of a tabor, therein there may be a
danger of disease.
आद्यन्तविस्तृतं यत् स्यात् संक्षिप्तं चापि मध्यतः।
मृदुमध्यं तदुद्दिष्टं क्षुद्भयं तत्र जायते ।।५६॥
That one which may be wider at the opening and end, and compressed at the centre, that
is declared as "Mrdumadhya".
There in a danger of hunger prevails.
विषमैरुन्नतैः कर्णैर्धनक्षयकरं गृहम्।
भित्तिवच्चापि कर्णेषु प्रागुक्तं फलमादिशेत्।।५७।।
The house of corners elevated and unevened, may be one as the wrester of wealth. And
at corners having a wall like structure, that may declare the fruit as declared earlier.
मध्ये द्वारं न कर्त्तव्यं मनुजानां कथञ्चन।
मध्ये द्वारे कृते तत्र कुलनाशः प्रजायते ।।५८।।
In the centre a door deserves not to be created for men by any means.
The door having
been raised in the centre, an extinction of the family gets in.
द्वारं द्वारेण वा विद्धमशुभायोपपद्यते।
अनिष्टद्रव्यसंयुक्तं धनधान्यविनाशनम्।।५ ९।।
A door entangled within a door becomes one for an inauspicious norm and one
equipped with not required materials becomes a destroyer of wealth and corn.

नवं पुराणसंयुक्तमन्यं स्वामिनमिच्छति।
अधोग्रं राजदण्डाय विद्धं द्वारं विगर्हितम् ।।६०।।
The newly built gate entwained by an old gate, looks for another owner and the one
having elevation from below to the top, becomes instrumental for a royal punishment and a
door entwined as such is despicable.
नवं पुराणसंयुक्तं द्रव्यं तु कलिकारकम्।
न मिश्रजातिद्रव्योत्थं द्वारं वा वेश्म वा शुभम् ।।६ १।।
A new material mixed up with old material is a source of dispute and in no way a house
created out of miscellaneous normed material or even a gate, is quite inauspicious.
गृहस्थानेषु यद् द्रव्यमधिवास्य प्रतिष्ठितम्।
तच्चालनेन चलनं गृहभर्तुः प्रजायते ।।६ २।।
In spots of a house, the material that is utilized having been perfumed, by a quaking of
that one the dislocation of the owner comes about.
अन्यवास्तुच्युतं द्रव्यमन्यवास्तौ न योजयेत्।
प्रासादे न भवेत् पूजा गृहे च न वसेद् गृही।।६३।।
A material residual from a different house, one may not employ in a different house.
(In
such a case) in the house there may not be possible any worship nor does an owner get
established therein.
द्रव्येण देवदग्धेन भवनं यद् विधीयते ।
न तत्र वसति स्वामी वसन्नपि विनश्यति ।। ६४।।
By the material burnt by Deva (Indra or rain god or thunderbolt) or (lightning) a house
that is created therein no owner happens to settle down and even when settled gets
bedoomed.
सूर्योद्भवा दुमच्छाया ध्वजच्छाया च गर्हिता।
द्वारातिक्रमणादेताः क्षुद्व्याधिकलिकारकाः ।।६५।।
The shadow of tree born of Sun (shine), and the shadow of a flag is detestable. By that
going beyond the gate they are generators of hunger, disease and disputes.
प्रासादशिखरच्छाया ध्वजच्छायेति कीर्तिता ।
त्रिपञ्चसप्तमी भर्तुर्गुहतारा न शोभना ।।६६।।
The shadow of the pinnacle of a mansion is termed as Dhvajacchayā or a shadow of the
flag. The third, fifth and seventh star of a house is not auspicious for the house owner.
निम्नोन्नतं करालं च सम्मुखं पृष्ठदेशगम्।
वामावर्तं च न शुभं द्वारमग्रतरं गृहे।।६७।।
Sunken and elevated, hideous one, frontal one and gone over to the rear portion, and

having a wrinkle towards the left, a door in the vanguard is no auspicious one in a house.
निम्ने स्यात् स्त्रीजितो भर्ता दुर्जनस्थितिरुन्नते।
सम्मुखे सुतपीडा स्यात् पृष्ठगे चपलाः स्त्रियः ।।६८।।
(The door) being sunken, the owner becomes one as won over by a wife and one being
elevated becomes a cause of malefied intentions or depraved norms or badly disposed.
In a
door facing the front a trouble to the son creeps in and when gone over to the back side, the
ladies become frivolous.
वामे वित्तक्षयो द्वारि (रे) भवत्यग्रतरे प्रभोः।
द्वारं तस्मान्न कर्तव्यमीदृग्यूपं विचक्षणैः ।।६९।।
The door being to the left there ensues the loss of wealth as also in case of one being on
the frontal portion the owner perishes.
The door, therefore, should not be created of this
norm by the experts.
नागदन्ततुलास्तम्भभित्तिमूषागवाक्षकाः ।
द्वारमध्ये न दातव्या न चैते विषमस्थिताः ।॥७०॥
Pegs, beams, poles, walls and round windows or air holes and ventilators deserve not to
be carved out at the centre of the door nor even unevenly built.
इतिहासपुराणोक्तं वृत्तान्तप्रतिरूपकम्। -
निन्दितं च गृहे नेष्टं शस्तं देवकुलेषु तत्।।७१।।
Guided by Itihāsa (chronicles) and Puranas (The Ancient Lore) the pictures chart of the
accounts being abhorrable is not desirable in a house but is deemed as laudable in temples.
यानीन्द्रजालतुल्यानि यानि मिथ्याकृतानि च।
भीषणानी च यानि स्युर्न कुर्यात् तानि वेश्मसु।॥७२॥
Those that may be compeers to magical feats and those created by farcical norms and
those that may be fierce looking or horrifying these one may not create in the houses.
स्वयमुद्धाटितं द्वारमुच्चाटनकरं भवेत्।
धनहृद् बन्धुवैरं स्यादथवा कलिकारकम्।।७३॥
Automatically opened apart or carved out a door may be a creator of expulsion or
exorcism (by way of a magical charm a wrester of wealth) a creator of enmity among
kinsfolk, or a creator of strife.
स्वयं तत् पिहितं द्वारं तद् भवेद् बहुदुःखदम्।
सशब्दं भयकृत् पादशीतलं गर्भपातनम्।।७४।।
A door that gets enblocked automatically, that may be a bestower of utmost woe and a
creaking one may be fear provoking, creator of cold in the feet and one effecting abortions.

द्रव्यं नाधोमुखं कार्यं प्रत्यग्याम्याननं न च।
पश्चिमाग्रे परिक्लेशो दक्षिणाग्रे तु शून्यता ।।७५।।
The material need not be placed as having face upside down and even having opening
towards the west and south;
when having face to the west, it may spell disaster and the
south faced one voidness or desolation or ruin.
स्तम्भद्वारं च भित्तिं च विपरीतं न कारयेत्।
अमीषां वैपरीत्येन दोषाः स्युर्बहवो नृणाम्।।७६।।
The door adjoining the pillars and a wall one may not create in a re erse order.
By the
reversal of these there may ensue many troubles for men.
मूलसूत्रानुसारेण कर्तव्या भूमिकोपरि।
उपर्युपरि यद् वेश्मसमं संतापकारकम्।। ७७।।
A storey above or at the roof deserves to be created in line with the fundamental
measuring tape.
Over and above that comes parallel to the mansion that may be torment
affording.
अधोभूमौ क्षणा ये स्युस्तत्समांश्चोर्ध्वभूमिषु।
परित्यजन्नपहिता (?) न कुर्वीत यथोत्तरम्।।॥७८॥
On the ground floor whichever dimensions there may be, leaving aside all those similar
to those on the upper storey one may not create as distinct as per subsequent norm.
शाला निम्ना भवेद् यस्मिन्नलिन्दस्त्वधिको भवेत्।
निधनं जायते तत्र सदा शोकभयानि च।॥७९॥
A room low lying may there be in whichever house, and the balcony or veranda may be
in elevation, a death invariably happens there and perennial sorrows and dangers may crop
up.
मूलद्वारानुसारेण द्वाराण्युपरिभूमिषु।
कुर्याद् भयप्रदानि स्युर्विहितान्यन्यथा पुनः।।८०।।
In line with the doors at the root the doors may be in that line over the upper storeys
and created as such quite otherwise, those may be horror provoking ones.
क्षुद्भयप्रदमाध्मा नं(तं) कुब्जं कुलविनाशनम्।
अत्यर्थं पीडितं पीडां करोत्यन्तनतं क्षयम्।।८ १।।
A bloated or bulged out door, is a creator of hunger and fears, and hunch backed as the
destroyer of the lineage.
Highly compressed causes pain and one bent at the end, a
demolition.

प्रवासो बाह्यविनते दिग्भ्रान्ते दस्युतो भयम्।
मूलद्वारं क्षयं कुर्याद् विद्धं द्वारान्तरेण यत्।।॥८२॥
Exile comes off when bulged out and when rotated in directions, may bring danger
from dacoits.
The fundamental gate may create demolition which one gets entwined by a
different gate.
प्रवासो भृत्यजो द्वेषो विद्धे चत्वररथ्यया।
नाशं द्रव्यं ध्वजाविद्धं वृक्षेण शिशुदूषकम् ।।८ ३।।
In case of a gate entangled within a lane leading to a square, there ensues an exile and
antipathy born of attendants.
The one flag entwined destroys the equipage or wealth and
one entwined by a tree, brings ailments for children.
पङ्कविद्धे भवेच्छोकः सलिलस्त्राविणि व्ययः।
कूपेन विद्धेऽपस्मारो विनाशो दैवतेन च।।८४।।
By a door slime-soaked, there may spell out grief and one trickling down water, may
involve expenditure when entangled within a well, epilepsy it may create, and destruction
when entangled by a temple.
स्तम्भेन दूषणं स्त्रीणां ब्रह्मणा तु कुलक्षयः।
मानादभ्यधिके द्वारे राजतो जायते भयम्।।८५॥
Pole contaminated it causes misconduct in women and entangled within a Brahma or
sacred or mystic syllable, the door of the lineage comes off.
In a door carved out in excess
of the measurement due, there ensues the danger from the king.
व्यसनं मानतो हीने चौरेभ्यश्च भयं भवेत्।
व्याधयः श्वभ्रविद्धेन धनस्य च परिक्षयः ।॥८६॥
In case of one lesser in extent than the (required) measurement, there may be danger
from the thieves.
By one having the defect of a hole or crevice, there may be diseases, and
loss of property.
देवध्वजेन बन्धः स्यात् सभयैश्वर्यसंक्षयः।
सन्निपातभयं वाप्या तुल्या दृष्टत्वमाकृते (?) ।।८७।।
By the Devadhvaja or Indramaha or Indra's festival there may be incarceration, fear
along with the loss of supremacy.
By the obstruction of an oblong tank, there may be the
danger of an onslaught and by a balance the facial disappearance.

व्याधिरुक् कचकूटेन आपाकेन  ( ) सुतक्षयः ।॥८८॥
By a potter's wheel, there may be heart disease and by water, penury.
By a Kucakūta (a
shag heap) the disease and fever and by Āpāka (tavern or water shed) the loss of a son.

तोयभाण्डेन दुर्मन्त्री भस्मना चार्शसो गृही।।८९।।
By a mortar, penury and by a boulder or stone slab, there may be strangury.
By a water
vessel, a bad minister and by ashes the owner gets afflicted by piles2 or hemorrhoege.
दारिद्र्यं छायया विद्धे भवेद् द्वारे कुटुम्बिनः।
स्थलस्यन्दनवल्मीकैर्विदेशगमनं भवेत् ।। ९०।।
When adumbrated by a shadow, the gate, there may crop up poverty for the owner, a
terrestrial vehicle, and an anthill or a dune, there may be a journey to the foreign soils.
कृशं विकृतमत्युच्चं करालं शिथिलं पृथु ।
वक्रं विशालमुत्तानं शू (स्थू) लाग्रं ह्रस्वकुक्षिकम् ।।९ १।।
Very lean ugly or disfigured highly elevated, hideous, flaccid, and even flatulent,
circuitous, broad, stretched or spread out having top equipped with a trident or spike and
having smaller abdominal spot.
स्वपादचलितं ह्रस्वं हीनकर्णं मुखानतम्।
पार्श्वगं सूत्रमार्गाच्च भ्रष्टं द्वारं न शोभनम् ।।९२॥
Mobile in personal pedestal, shorter one, having no flanks and stooped down at the
opening.
Sick tracked and deranged from the passage of measuring tape, a door is not an

तत् करोति क्षयं घोरं विनाशं स्वामिसम्पदः।
वसतां कलहं नित्यमतस्तत् परिवर्जयेत्।।९ ३।।
That spells horrible disaster and a loss to owner's properties for those residing herein
and may create constant disputes. Such a ones may evade.
अन्तर्द्वाराद् बहिर्द्धारं नोच्चं कुर्यान्न सङ्कटम्।
उच्चं विसङ्कटं वापि तच्छिवाय न जायते ।।९४।॥
From an inner door, an outer door neither very high nor very dingy one may get into

In case in a temple, the flags follow the trail of a diagonal then of Age and wealth a

Adjusted or fixed on the threshold and the upper block that beam named Lalații brings

Adjusted within the interior of the Uttaranga (a back spot) when it may be similar to

circle.
तुलापिण्डेन विन्यस्ता ज्ञेया यज्ञोपवीतिनी।
वसतो व्यसनं कुर्यात् कुटुम्बस्यासुखं च सा ।।१००।।
Fixed with a beam clod, the beam may be called Yajñopavitini i.e. an investiture thread

By the tips of the beams, the truncation of the wall deserves not to be done.

By a highly flatulent and tiny body the way a man is ugly and weak, by that type of a

Dilapidated and eaten by worms, miscellaneous, deficient, curved, deranged from the

the squares or quadrangular

Those grown within the temples of gods, desiccated at the top and having leaves

Kovidāra, Dhava, Arişța, Śleşmātaka and Vibhitaka, and added to that Saptacchada,
Kşiris, the fruit bearing ones, these trees are may discard.

The vulnerable points wherein are bruised, or acrimonised by door and walls likewise,
one may declare there the penury and loss of lineage of the house-holder.
स्तम्भैर्विनश्यति स्वामी तुलाभिः स्त्रीवधो ध्रुवम्।
सङ्ग्रहैर्बन्धुनाशः स्याज्जयन्तीभिः स्नुषावधः ।।११८॥
Owing to acrimonisation by the pillars, the householder becomes bedoomed and by
acrimonisation of beams the murder of a women results and by store rooms acrimonisation
of vulnerable points the loss or extinction of kindreds results and by Jayantis (i.e. Flags) the
murder of a daughter-in-law results.
मर्मस्थानस्थितैः कायैर्भर्तुः कायो निपीड्यते ।
मर्मस्यैः सन्धिपालैस्तु सुहृद्विश्लेषमादिशेत्।।११९।।

By the torsos or trunks stationed within the vulnerable points, the body of the owner
becomes compressed or tortured and by the Sandhipalas (The joint preservers) one may
indicate the death of allies.
गृहपीडा नागदन्तैर्नागपाशैर्धनक्षयः ।
कापिच्छकैस्तु प्रेष्याणां क्षयं मर्मस्थितैर्वदेत्।। १२० ।।
By pegs' obstruction of vulnerable points there ensues trouble to the house, and by
snake-snares, the loss of wealth and by Kapicchakas¹ entangling the vulnerable points
result in the loss of servants.
षड्दारुकान्यनुसरागवाक्षालोकनानि च।
मर्मस्थाननिविशनि जनयन्ति महाभयम्।।१२ १।।
Şaddārukas (i.e. six knotted foggot) Anusaras (patches) or cracks and lattices and
ālokanas (apertures) incorporated within the vulnerable points generate mighty terror.
स्तम्भैर्वा द्वारमध्यैर्वा तुलाभिर्नागपाशकैः।
वातायनैर्नागदन्तैर्द्वारमध्ये निपीडिते ।। १२२॥
The door abdomen gone obscured by poles, or by dvāra madhyas (panel depressions) by
beams or snake coils (magical nooses used in battles for entangling an enemy)2 by windows
or ventilators or pegs.
व्याधयः संप्रवर्धन्ते धननाशः कुलक्षयः।
राजदण्डभयं च स्यादपत्यानां च पीडनम्।। १२३।।

The malad i.e., get multiplied, loss of wealth and family demolition and there may even

In the centres of the Şaddarukas and even in the door abdominal, becoming obstructed
by Karnadravyas (the sidereal knots or extra fungus or fungi) the same outcome may one
enunciate.
संविद्धा नागदन्तैर्या स्तम्भैर्वातायनैस्तथा।
शय्या शस्त्राद् भयं भर्तुः कुर्यात् तस्करतोऽपि वा।।१२५॥
The couch contaminated by projecting pegs, by poles and by ventilators, may entail
danger from weapon or even by thieves or smugglers.
गृहमध्ये कृतं द्वारं द्रव्यकोशविनाशनम्।
आवहेत् कलहं भर्तुर्भार्यां वास्य प्रदूषयेत्।।१२६।।
A door created in the centre of a house, is the destroyer of wealth and treasury and may
carry out a quarrel with the owner or may result in the unchastity of his wife.
द्रव्येणैकोत्तरेणापि महामर्मणि पीडिते ।
सर्वस्वनाशो गृहिणो मरणं वा ध्रुवं भवेत्।।१२७।।
The broader vulnerable points gone obstructed by an additional material becomes
instruments in the destruction of everything of the householder or even the certainty of

Then within the pedestal of that one there is the breadth and length of two parts.
The
Prāsāda Rucaka deserves to be created having height of a triad of parts. 2
सिंहो वृत्तश्चतुष्कोणः षोडशाष्टा श्रयस्तथा। इत्येते विंशतिः प्रोक्ताः प्रासादाः संज्ञया मया यथोक्तानुक्रमेणैव लक्षणानि
वदाम्यतः ।। Brhat Samhitā 56.17-19 p.540-541. M.R.K.
Bhat's edition, MLBD, Delhi.
1. Bhadra- a type of partico; a moulding, the general epithet of chariots, a type of building.
(EOHA
p.370 and p.407)
2. Rucaka - समचतुरस्रोरुचकोवजोऽष्टश्रिदिवज्रको द्विगुणः द्वात्रिशेता तु मध्ये प्रलीनिको वृत्तः इति वृत्तः । Brhat Samhitā
53.28, p.
459, Part I, M.R.K. Bhat ed. and 35 p. 401.
प्राक्पश्चिभावलिन्दावन्तगतौ तदविस्थितौ शेषौ।

सार्धभागेन संछा स्यात् सार्धभागस्तु योऽपरः (?)।
छाय (द्य) त्रयं सकण्ठं स्यात् तेन सामलसारकम्।। २८।।
By a half of the portion there may be a Samchă (a covering) or an enclosure and the
half portion that is the other one, the coverage triad or a roof triad with a neck may be there
accompanied by an "Amalasārakal".
द्वारं भागोच्छ्रितं तस्य कार्यं भागार्धविस्तृतम्।
सप्राग्रीवः स कर्तव्यश्चतुर्दशधरावृतः ।। २९ ।।
The door of that one should be created having height of one portion and having breadth
of half a part equipped with an entrance hall that should be created covered by fourteen
dharās.
ससौधालिन्दकश्वारुरूर्ध्वच्छाद्योपकर्षवान्।
क्रियतेऽत्र यदा स्तम्भा ( ) द्वाविंशत्या समावृतः ।।३०।।
Lovely having the balconies and chambers having the open space with upper roofs
when it created with pillars thirty two forming an enclosure.
सप्राग्रीवपरिष्कारो भागिकालिन्दशोभितः।
मध्यप्रदेशे रुचकः प्रासादः परिकीर्तितः ।॥३१।।
Having polish of entrance halls equipped with sidereal balconies in Madhya Pradeśa the
palace is declared as Rucaka (the popular one).
रुचकः।
कर्णप्राग्रीवकै श्चित्रैः सप्राग्रीवश्च यो वृतः।
द्वाभ्यां द्वाभ्यां गवाक्षाभ्यां चतुर्दिशमलङ्कृतः ।॥३२॥
By varied normed flanked entrance halls that which stands surrounded by entrance
halls, decked by two windows on the four sides each.
कपोतालीपरिक्षिप्तः शोभितो द्वारसम्पदा।
रुचके द्वारे न शुभदमुत्तरतोऽन्यानि शस्तानि ।
Brhat Samhitā (53.35)
In the building known as Rucaka the eastern and western verandahs touch the ends in the south
and north and touching these two internally there are two more.
In this building an entrance in
the north is not auspicious while in the other, quarters they are good.
P. 461, M.R.K. Bhat. Dr.
N.M. Kansara says Rucaka having two terraces touching the ends in the west and east and
touching these two internally two more and one door on each side except in the north.
Sambodhi
p. 113, Vol. XXII, 1998-99. L.D. Institute of Ideology, Ahmedabad.
1. Amalasāraka- Fluted oblate splendid resembling an Amalaka fruit which resting on a dado
(Kantha or beki) forms the crowning element of Nagara and Rekhā temples.

तदानीं चित्रकुटाख्यः प्रासादः सोऽभिधीयते ।। ३३ ।।
Covered by dove cots and englamoured by the glory of doors then that Prāsāda is
defined as one having name Citrakūta.
चित्रकूटः ।
अयमेव पुनः षड्भिः स्तम्भैरपि चितो यदा।
प्राग्रीवकविहीनश्च स भवेज्जालरूपकः ॥३४।।
सिंहपञ्जर इत्युक्तः प्रासादः स तदा शुभः।
सिंहपञ्जरः।
कर्णप्राग्रीवकौ द्वौद्वावस्यैव भवतो यदा।। ३५ ।।
This very one when brick-lain by six poles or pillars or columns again, and divested of
entrance halls that may be one having superimposition of networks then that Prāsāda may
be called as "Simha Pañjara", the auspicious one.
And the sidereal entrance halls two each
when there assume existence.
अलिन्दकगतिस्थित्या तदा भद्रः प्रकीर्तितः।
भद्रः।
स्याच्चित्रकूट प्राग्रीवैश्चतुर्भिर्दिक्चतुष्टये ।। ३६ ।।
By the adjustment of the structuring of balconies or verandahs, then it may be called as
Bhadra.
The Citrakūța equipped with four entrance halls is in the four quarters having four
gates inside and outside or exterior and interior ones, then it may be named as Śrīkūța.
बहिरन्तश्चतुर्द्वारः श्रीकूट इति नामतः।
श्रीकूटः ।
षड्दारुकसमायुक्तप्राग्द्वारस्त्वयमेव चेत्।।३७।।
And if this very one has eastern gates equipped with Şaddārukas (Grills) the Prāsāda
having columns inside grilled as such, then it is called Uşnişa.
प्रासादस्तम्भगर्भः स्यात् तदोष्णीषोऽभिधीयते।
उष्णीषः।
चतुरंशकविस्तीर्णं षडंशविहितायति ।। ३८।।
पीठं शालागृहस्योक्तं सशालानिर्गमं शुभम्।
मध्यादपरतस्तस्य द्विभागायतविस्तृतम्।। ३९।।
Having breadth of four fractions and having length of six fractions, the pedestal of a
Śālā grha (compartmental building) is declared as such having door way to the
compartments, auspicious as such from the centre of the other side or west of that one,
having breadth and length of two parts.

विधेयं गर्भभवनमलिन्दकपरिष्कृतम्।
कार्या तस्याग्रतः सीमा भागद्वितयमायता ।।४०।।
Deserves to be built a structure belonging to the centre or an interior structure of central
structure, polished by balconies or verandahs or terraces and deserves to be created a
terminus or terminal spot or boundary having length of two parts.
भागमेकं च विस्तीर्णा चतुः स्तम्भोपशोभिता।
तदग्रतोऽपरा सीमा कार्या भागान् षडायता ।।४१।।
Having breadth of one part, and englamoured by four pillars another Sīmā (a
boundary), deserves to be created in the frontal region in line with the components, having
length of six (such components).
तिर्यक्स्था भागविस्तीर्णा प्रवेशद्वयशोभिता।
एष शालागृहः (?) स्तम्भैर्द्वाविंशत्या समावृतः ।॥४२॥
Horizontally established broad only by a single part, decked by an entrance twain or
door way twain, this building having rooms deserves to be enclosed by pillars or columns
of twenty two (cubits).
प्राग्रीववेदिकाजाल पक्षसोपानकैः शुभैः।
पञ्चभागोन्मितव्यासे क्षेत्रभागाष्टकायते ।। ४३।।
पीठं कुर्यादुभयतः ससोपानं शिलाचितम्।
मध्यादपरभागेऽस्य देवागारं निवेशयेत्।।४४।।
Entrance hall, a raised pavilion or a lattice, and flanked staircases, of auspicious norm,
within a breadth of five parted circumference having length of octagonal space, a pedestal
are may create on both sides accompanied by a rundle stone inlaid.
From the centre of this
one on the opposite sides one may create a temple of god.
वि(द्वि) भागायामविस्तारं चतुरश्रं सुसंहितम्।
पादोनभागविस्तारमध्यर्थं भागमुच्छ्रितम्।।४५।।
तस्य कार्यं मुखं मध्ये पार्श्वतश्चयशोभितम्।
सचया निर्गता सीमा द्वौ भागौ त्रींस्तथायथा (ता) ।।४६।।
Having breadth and length of part twain square shaped well endorsed of  parts breadth
and half a part in height, the doorway of that one deserves to be created in the centre,
decked by a brick lining from the flanks.
A boundary enunciated having brick linings
adjusted having two parts (breadth) and three parted length.
चतुरश्रा चतुः स्तम्भा तदत्रे भागविस्तृता।
पञ्चभागायता तिर्यक् कार्या सीमा तथापरा ।।४७॥

Square shaped, four columned, having breadth of apart in front of that five parted in
length and horizontal deserves to be created another boundary.
द्वात्रिंशदत्र कर्त्तव्याः स्तम्भाः सर्वेक्यसंख्यया।
बहिः परिसरो गर्भात् ससीम्नो भागविस्तृतः ।।४८।।
By the counting of a uniform norm, 32 columns are to be created herein and on the
outside, an enclosure from the centre along with the boundary broad by a part.
एवं स्याद् वेदिकाजालरूपादिभिरलङ्कृतः ।
बहिर्व (श्च) योच्छ्रितश्चैष प्रासादो गजयूथपः ।।४९।।
This way may there be decorated by a Vedikā (raised platform or a pavilion) and
latticed frameworks having height brick lined on the outside, this Prāsāda Gajayūthāpa.
गजयूथपः।
षड्भागभाजिते क्षेत्रे चतुरश्रे समन्ततः।
गर्भो द्विभागिकः कार्यो द्वारं भागसमुच्छ्रितम्।।५०।।
In an area divided into six parts, square shaped all around, a central part of two
divisions deserves to be created and a doorway having height of a part.
भागार्थं द्वारविस्तारः प्रासादस्योच्छ्रितिं पुनः।
कुर्वीत चतुरो भागाञ् छादयेच्चित्रकूटवत्।।५ १।।
The doorway breadth being of a half fraction and that very way the height of his
Prāsāda, then may create and may cover up four parts like the Citrakūța (type).
कार्या द्विभागिकाः शालाः सालिन्दास्तस्य बाह्यतः।
बहिर्भित्तिपरिक्षिप्ताश्चतुर्भागायताः शुभाः ॥५२॥
The rooms deserve to be created as having two compartments equipped with balconies
on the exterior of that enclosed by outside ramparts or walls having length of four parts as
such (quite) auspicious ones.
द्वौ द्वौ गवाक्षकौ स्तम्भाः प्रतिशालं भवन्ति षट्।
चतुः स्तम्भधृतैर्युक्ताः कार्या वा धार्मिकालयैः ।।५ ३।।
Two windows each and the columns in every room are six normally or may be created
as endowed with four columned roofs or architraves or beam or cron beams through the
religious sanctuaries.
नन्द्यावर्तोऽयमेवं स्यात् सप्राग्रीवचतुष्टयः ।
प्रागु (?) द्वारक्षणोपेतः प्रासादः शुभलक्षणः ।।५४।।

Nandyavartta¹ the this very may be such having tetrad of entrance halls equipped with
eastern gate and a grill, the Pasada called Kşana of good ensigns.
नन्द्यावर्तः ।
क्षेत्र (त्रे) षद्भागविस्तारे दशभागकृतायतौ।
मध्यादपरभागेऽस्य देवकोष्ठं निवेशयेत्।।५५।।
In an area of six parted breadth, and having length created by ten parts, from the centre,
in the opposite side, of this one may create a temple chamber.
चतुरंशप्रतिन्यासं चतुरश्रं समन्ततः ।
द्वारं तस्य विधातव्यं भागमध्यर्धमुच्छ्रितम् ।।५६।॥
Having a counter assortment of four parts and square normed all around the doorway of
that one deserves to be created having height of one and a half part.
पादोनं भागविस्तारं सिंहवक्त्रविभूषितम्।
सीमा तस्याग्रतः कार्या देवकोष्ठेन सम्मिता ।।५७।।
$3/4^{th}$ of a part the breadth, decorated by a lion's face, the boundary in front of that is to
be created equipped with a temple chamber.
स्तम्भैः षोडशभिर्युक्ता भागद्वितयमुच्छ्रितैः।
ससीम्नो देवकोष्ठस्य समन्ताद् भित्तिवेष्टितः ।॥५८॥
Equipped with sixteen columns having height of part twain, surrounded by a wall all
around the temple chamber, having a boundary.
अलिन्दो भागिकः कार्यो गवाक्षैरुपशोभितः।
(तत्) सीम्नोश्चाग्रतः पार्श्वे षड्दारुकयुता बहिः ।।५९।।
A balcony having a single component deserves to be created decorated by windows and
on the situate situation of the front of the two boundaries, equipped with latticed screen or
grill on the outskirts.
कार्या द्विरंशाः प्राग्रीवा भागिकालिन्दवेष्टिताः।
1. नन्द्यावनर्त्तमलिन्दैः शालाकुड्यात् प्रदक्षिणान्तयतैः। द्वारं पश्चिममस्मिन् विहाय शेषाणि कार्याणि ।। Brhat Samhitā 53.32,
pp. 460, M.R.K. Bhat ed.
A house which has verandahs starting from the walls of the halls and
going to their respective extremities from left to right is termed Nandyavritta which should have
only three doors leaning off the western one.
Dr. N.M. Kansara says in Sambodhi XXII, 1998-
1999, p.
112 Nandyāvartta a structure, with verandahs starting from the wall of the hall and
going to the extremity from left to light with a door on each side except in the west based on
Ajay Mitra Sastri IASITBSOVM, p.
383 (Nandyāvartta).

द्विद्विस्तम्भघृताः सर्वे पार्श्वतश्चयशोभिताः ।।६०।।
Deserve to be created entrance halls of two parts surrounded by fractional balconies
propped up by two columns each, all decorated by brick linings from close quarters or on
the flank.
अलिन्दास्तु चतुः स्तम्भाः कार्याः प्राग्रीवकाग्रतः ।
अवतंसक इत्येषः सर्वलक्षणसंयुतः ।।६ १।।
The terraces or balconies deserve to be created as having four columns (supporting
them) from the front of the entrance halls - Avatamsaka this way is this one as equipped
with all the qualities.
प्रासादः कथितः सम्यक्
अवतंसः।
स्वस्तिकः प्रोच्यतेऽधुना।
चतुरश्रीकृते क्षेत्रे षड्‌भागप्रविभाजिते।।६ २।।
The Prāsāda Avatamsa, has been illustrated quite suitably "Svastika" Prāsāda is being
illustrated within an area created square shaped as such, divided into six parts.
प्रासादं कल्पयेन्मध्ये द्विभागायामविस्तृतम्।
द्वारपाशोऽस्य भागार्थविस्तृतो भागिकोदयः ।।६३
One may create the mansion in the centre, having breadth and length of two parts or
cubits.
The door lock of this one or the gate latch of this one having breadth of half a part
and having an elevation of a fraction norm.
गर्भवेश्म चतुः स्तम्भमलिन्दो भागिको बहिः।
तस्य स्युर्द्वादश स्तम्भा भागिकोऽलिन्दकोऽपरः ।।६४।।
The central chamber having four columns and the balcony of a fractional constitution
on the outside.
Of that the columns may be twelve and a balcony of an extra normed
fractional competence.
विंशतिस्तम्भसंयुक्तो विधातव्यः समन्ततः।
चयावृतश्च पुरतो भागो वाष्टधरान्वितः ।।६५।।
Equipped with twenty columns deserves to be created all around, covered by brick
lining from the front, the segregated portion endowed with eight dharas.
भागमेकैकमुत्सृज्य कर्णाभ्यां भागविस्तृतौ।
भागिकोच्छ्रायनिष्कासौ कार्यों प्राग्रीवकौ पुनः।।६६।।
Having spared one part each, by the two Karņas, in the breadth of a part, having exits of
fractional heights, two entrance halls deserve to be created.

वाह्यतो भित्तिसंश्लिष्टौ त्रिदिशं सगवाक्षकौ।
स्वस्तिकोऽयं समाख्यातः प्रासादश्चित्रलक्षणः ।।६७।।
From the outside enclosed by walls and having windows on three sides, this type of
Prāsāda is called "Svastika" of varied pre-requisites.!
स्वस्तिकः।
अथाभिधीयतेऽधुना प्रासादः शुभलक्षणः।
षड्भागभाजिते क्षेत्रे चतुरश्रे समन्ततः ।॥६८॥
Now is being defined the Prāsāda of auspicious ensigns or (Śubhalakşana) by name. In
the area or field divided into six segments, square shaped all around.
द्विभागायामविस्तारं मध्ये गर्भगृहं भवेत्।
भागद्वयोच्छ्रितैः स्तम्भैर्युतं व्यक्तैः सलक्षणैः ॥६९॥
Having breadth and length of two segments there may be a central hall within the
centre equipped with columns having height of two segments of apparent qualities.
निष्क्रान्तेषु बहिर्भागे गर्भपादेषु योजयेत्।
तोरणानि मनोज्ञानि ककुप्सु चतसृष्वपि ।।७०।।
On the outer side also the internal pedestals projected as such, one may fix up arched
portals gorgeous ones in the four quarters.
गर्भस्तम्भप्रमाणेन तानि स्तम्भद्वयेन वा।
समुत्क्षिप्तानि युक्तानि कलशैः रविमण्डलैः ।।७१।।
By the extent of the central column those ones or by a column twain, elevated as such
and equipped or fixed with ewers of the circular orb of the norm of sun.
पल्लवैः पत्रजात्यादिविन्यासैश्चाप्यनेकशः।
भूषितास्ये पुनर्मूर्ध्नि मकराणां मुखैरपि ।।७२।।
1. In the Svastika type of mansion the western verandah should extend from the left hall to the right
one.
The other two verandahs (southern and northern) originating from the western verandah
should touch the ends in the east, and the fourth one (i.e. eastern one) is held between their
bounds.
Such a mansion with only an eastern entrance is beneficial (i.e. Svastika).

# Chapter 56: The Illustration of Sixty-Four Prāsādas Headed by Rucaka
*(From the Samarāṅgaṇasūtradhāra by Mahārājādhirāja Śrī Bhojadeva)*

## 1. Introduction and Materials
The chapter enumerates sixty-four *Prāsādas* (temples or mansions) equipped with *śikharas* (roofs/spires), starting with the *Rucaka*. These temples are designed to fulfill all desires and bestow bliss and emancipation.

### Permitted Materials and their Significance:
* **Gold and Silver:** Beloved by all gods; grants all desires.
* **Gems, Pearls, Corals:** Used for highly auspicious and decorative temples.
* **Brass, Copper, Bell-metal (Kāṃsya):** Associated with *Piśācas* (ghouls) and *Rākṣasas* (demons).
* **Stone and Marble (Sphaṭika):** Ordained for temples in the *Pātāla* (netherworld).
* **Bricks, Wood, and Stones:** In the mortal world (*Martyaloka*), these materials create gladdening temples (*Nandakas*) that bring bliss to both the architect (*Sthapati*) and the patron/builder.

## 2. Classification of the Prāsādas

### The Twenty-Five Basic Forms (Lalitas)
These base temples are categorized by their geometric footprints:
1. **Square-Shaped (18 types):** Rucaka, Bhadraka, Haṃsa, Haṃsodbhava, Pratihaṃsa, Nanda, Nandyāvartta, Dharādhara, Vardhamāna, Adrikūṭa, Śrīvatsa, Trikūṭaka, Muktakoṇa, Gaja, Garuḍa, Siṃha.
2. **Square or Rectangular (2 types):** Bhava, Vibhava.
3. **Globular / Circular (2 types):** Padma, Mālādhara.
4. **Globular and Oblong (2 types):** Malaya, Makaradhvaja.
5. **Octagonal (3 types):** Vajraka, Svastika, Śaṅku.

### The Miśrakas (Mixed Structural Norms)
There are nine primary mixed structural designs:
Subhadra, Kirīṭa, Sarvatobhadra, Siṃhakesarī, Citrakūṭa, Dharādhara, Tilaka, Svatilaka, and Sarvāṅgasundara.

Other notable complex variations include:
Kesarī, Nandana, Nandiśālaka, Nandīśa, Mandira, Śrīvṛkṣa, and Amṛtodbhava.

## 3. Specific Temple Designs and Proportions

### The Meru Prāsāda
* **Deities:** Exclusively dedicated to the Hindu Trinity—Hara (Śiva), Hiraṇyagarbha (Brahmā), Hari (Viṣṇu)—and Bhāskara (The Sun).
* **Builder & Architect Rules:** The patron should be a Kṣatriya and the architect a Vaiśya. If a Brāhmaṇa acts as the architect, his purity and prowess are said to diminish. If a Kṣatriya king builds it using a Kṣatriya architect, it leads to national ruin. The correct pairing ensures undecaying merit.
* **Structure:** A massive square plot divided into segments. Features a central chamber (*Garbhagṛha*), a prominent entrance hall (*Prāggrīva*), and an intricate roof (*Śikhara*) topped with a *Padmakośa*, *Grīvā* (neck), *Āmalasāraka* (fluted spheroid), *Padmaśīrṣa*, and *Kalaśa* (finial).
* **Scale:** Can be built in larger (50 cubits breadth), middling (38 cubits), or smaller sizes (30 cubits). Covered by a hundred peaks (*Śataśṛṅga*).

### Other Notable Prāsādas
* **Rucaka:** The fundamental square temple.
* **Bhadraka:** A Rucaka equipped with a triad of *Bhadras* (projections).
* **Haṃsa / Haṃsodbhava:** Features internal water channels (*Jalāntara*).
* **Nandyāvartta:** Entails a victory-bestowing design with an entrance hall decorated by twin columns.
* **Gaja:** Dedicated to Gaṇeśa. Features a *Śūrasena* arch in the front and a tusker-shaped (*Gajākṛti*) rear.
* **Garuḍa:** Dedicated to Viṣṇu (*Garuḍadhvaja*). Features two flanking wings matching the scale of the *Vardhamāna*.
* **Vṛṣabha:** Dedicated to Śiva (*Vṛṣabhadhvaja*).
* **Sarvatobhadra:** A highly auspicious square temple ensuring progeny and heavenly abode. It has elaborate storeys, *Rathikās* (niches/shrines), and an entrance on all four sides.
* **Hemakūṭa:** Visually resembling a snow-clad mountain (Himalayas), it serves as an abode for the Trinity.

## 4. Deity Placement and Architectural Vulnerabilities (*Marmavedha*)

Proper placement of deities across the temple complex is critical to maintaining cosmic harmony.

### Directional Alignments:
* **Northeast (Aiśānī):** Īśa (Śiva)
* **Southeast (Āgneyī):** Puruṣottama (Viṣṇu)
* **Northwest (Vāyukoṇa):** Brahmā
* **Southwest (Nairṛta):** Divākara (The Sun)
* **Center (Madhya):** Śiva (or the primary deity)
* **East:** Purandara (Indra)
* **South (Yāmyā):** Dharma/Yama
* **West:** Varuṇa
* **North:** Soma (The Moon)

### Divine Oppositions and Rules:
* The primary deities—Hara, Hiraṇyagarbha, Hari, and Dinakara—are considered mutually opposed in specific alignments.
* Their temples must not be situated to the direct right (south) or left of one another improperly.
* If a new, subordinate temple is to be built, it should be placed to the north of the main temple at a specific distance (36 or 39 cubits).

### Avoiding Vulnerable Spots (*Marmas*):
The architect (*Sthapati*) must carefully map out and avoid the structural vulnerable points (*Marmavedha*). Placing heavy building materials directly on a *Kṣaṇamadhya* (critical juncture) out of ignorance will invite affliction upon both the builder and the architect, rendering the temple unfit for worship.

**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `ऊर्ध्वमानमिह प्रोक्तं द्विगुणं द्विकलाधिकम्।।१८०।।`
**English Translation:** *Two squared may be the wall of the Kanda and the interior as twelve parted one. The*

measurement of the upper part or roof is spoken of redoubled as exceeding by two Kalās.

**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `चतुर्विंशतिभागाने्त तुलोच्छ्रायस्य मध्यतः।`
**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `ऊर्ध्वमानं तु यत् प्रोक्तं ग्रीवाण्डाद्यं ततो बहिः।।१८१।।`
**English Translation:** *At the end of the twenty four parts in the centre of the elevation or height of the*

architrave or beam, the measurement of the roof that stands spoken headed by Grīvāṇḍa and

the like on the outskirts of that.

**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `कार्ये(तुलोदयं स्यांच?) वेदीबन्धोऽशसप्तकम्।`
**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `त्रिभागं कुम्भकः सूत्रं(?)सार्धभागो मसूरकः||१८२||`
**English Translation:** *At the end of this height of the architrave deserves to be created the height of the*

architrave of septagonal digits. Three parted therein the Kumbhaka and Masūraka of a part

and a half.

**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `भागेनान्तरपत्रं स्यात् सार्धभागेन् मेखला।`
**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `जङ्घ द्वादशभिर्भागैर्द्व्यंशा वा गलपट्टिका(:?)||१८३||`
**English Translation:** *By a part the Antarapattra, and by a part and a half Mekhalā Jaṅghā may be by twelve*

parts and two parted may be galapaṭṭikā.

**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `अन्धारिका च भागार्धं सार्धभागा वरण्डिका।`
**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `भागेनान्तरपत्रं स्याद् रूपकर्मसमाकुलम्।।१८४।।`
**English Translation:** *Andhakārikāmay be of a half part and Varāṇḍakā of apart and a half. By a part may be*

Antarapattra, and the rūpaka of unequal norm.

**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `ऊर्ध्वाधःपट्टयोर्मध्ये(ध्य)भागो भागैकविंशतिः।`
**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `अतो मध्याद् विधातव्यं द्विपदं राजसेनकम्।।१८५।।`
**English Translation:** *In the centre of the upper and lower paṭṭa, the part of twenty one parts may there be.*

From the centre of this deserves to be created two parted Rājasenaka.

**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `वेदी चतुष्पदा प्रोक्ता भागेनासनपट्टकः।`
**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `पदद्वयेन सार्धेन कार्यं चन्द्रावलोकनम्।।१८६।।`
**English Translation:** *The Vedī is spoken of as of four squares, and the āsanapaṭṭaka of one square and by*

pada twain having one and a half deserves to be created Candrāvalokana.

**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `नवभागोच्छ्रितः स्तम्भः पत्रकर्मसमाकुलः।`
**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `भागेनेकेन भरणं शीर्षकं च द्विभागिकम्।।१८७।।`
**English Translation:** *The column having height of nine parts, having carving of floral patterns and by a part*

the Bharaṇa and Śīrṣaka as of part-twain.

**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `उच्छालकमुभौ भागों हारग्रहणमासिकम् (?)।`
**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `द्व्यंशा पट्टोच्छ्रितिर्भागचतुष्का वाह्यविस्तृतिः।।१८८।।`
**English Translation:** *Ucchālaka or Utkālaka on both the sides hirāgrahaṇa¹ by a part. The height of paṭṭaka of*

two digits and the outer breadth as of part square.

**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `(द्व्यंशांशालम्बनोध्वें² तु रूपकँ चक पट्टिका:?)||`
**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `सा च भागत्रयेण स्यात् सुश्लिष्टा साधुचित्रिता।।१८९।।`
**English Translation:** *The Rūpaka and Balapaṭṭikā have roof of a height of two digits. And that may be nicely*

chequered or painted well knit as such by a part-triad.

**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `कर्णकर्णेषु शृङ्गाणां विस्तृतिर्द्विपदा भवेत्।`
**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `ऊर्ध्वमानं त्रिभागं स्याद् ग्रीवाण्डलकलशैः सह।।१९०।।`
**English Translation:** *On the Karṇa Karṇas of the Śṛṅgas the breadth may be of two squares. The upper*

measurement may be of three parts along with grīvāṇḍaka Kalaśas.

**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `मध्ये चतुष्पदा कर्णा(र्णा) दुरोमञ्जरिका भवेत्।`
**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `उच्छ्रायः षट्पदस्तस्या ग्रीवाण्डं द्विपदोच्छ्रितम्||१९१||`
**English Translation:** *In the centre from the Karṇas of four squares, there may be Uramañjarīkā. The height of*

that may be hexagonal and grīvāṇḍa elevated by two parts.

**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `भागेन कलशोत्सेधः स्यादेवं कर्णनिर्मित(ति):।`
**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `कर्णाश्च पिण्डिका कार्या भद्रदेशे तथोच्छ्रितः||१९२||`
**English Translation:** *By a part the elevation of the Kalaśa and this very way may be the construction of the*

Karṇa. The Karṇas and piṇḍikā deserves to be created in the Bhadradeśa elevated likewise.

**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `कर्तव्यः सप्तभिर्भागैः सिंहकर्णः सुचर्चितः।`
**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `कर्णद्वये तथा शृङ्गं तयोर्ध्वं चतुर्दिशम्।।१९३।।`

**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `एकोनत्रिंशदण्डोऽयं प्रासादः शुभलक्षणः।`

**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `विजयभद्रः।।`

Godo health or freedom from disease and acquisition of a son, for those taking to

victory or victory endowing one. Unto them gets pleased the six faced one, i.e. Gaṇeśa¹

who adore him with devotion.

**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `अधुना श्रीनिवासाख्यः प्रासादः सभ्यगुच्यते।`
**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `तृप्त्यर्थमेव क्रियते जयश्रीस्तत्र तिष्ठति।।२०१।।`
**English Translation:** *Now is being described in details the Prāsāda named Śrīnivāsa. It is created only for the*

sake of satisfaction and victory and glory abide therein.

**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `चतुश्रीकृते क्षेत्रे भक्तेऽष्टादशभिः पदैः।`
**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `अन्धारिका च भित्ते(त्ति)श्च प्रदे द्वे द्वे यथाक्रमम्।।२०२।।`
**English Translation:** *In a field four square shaped divided by eighteen segments, Andhakārikā and bhitti*

(wall) are of pada twain each.

**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `गर्भश्च षट्पदः कार्यः श्रीनिवासस्य सुन्दरः।`
**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `कन्दे स्युर्द्विपदाः कर्णा भागेन सलिलान्तरम्||२०३||`
**English Translation:** *The garbha is to be created as hexagonal normed of Śrīnivāsa the beautiful one and on*

Kunda may be pada twained Karṇas and by apart the water channel.

**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `भद्रं चतुष्पदं कार्यं पदेनैकेन निर्गतम्।`
**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `बाह्याः स्युस्त्रिपदाः कर्णा भद्रैश्च द्विपदैर्युताः||२०४||`
**English Translation:** *Bhadra should be created as four squared projected by a single part. The outer Karṇa*

may be of part-triad equipped with Bhadras of pada-twain.

**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `भद्रं चतुर्थकर्णेषु(तु) पदेनैकेन निर्गतम्।`
**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `क्रोणकोणाश्च कर्तव्याः पदस्यार्ध समायताः।।२०५।।`
**English Translation:** *The bhadra in the fourth Karṇa is to be projected by one part and Koṇa Koṇas deserve*

to be created as equally oblong by a half part.

**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `पदेनाम्बुधरः कार्यः प्रवेशाद् विस्तृतेरपि।`
**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `विस्तारात् षट्पदं भद्रं पदद्वयनिर्गमम्।।२०६।।`
**English Translation:** *By a pada Ambudhara decease to be created from the entrance of the breadth and*

Bhadra is to be of hexagonal norm from the breadth having an exit door of pada twain.

**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `नीरस्यालान्तरे(?) कार्या(:) तिलका द्व्यंशविस्तृताः।`
**Sanskrit (Śloka):** `पदेनैकेन निष्क्रान्ताः शोभिताश्चारुकर्मणा।।२०७।।`
**English Translation:** *Within the Nirasyāla deserves to be created Tilakas two digited normed broad projected*

by a single part, and beautified by good workmanship.

# Chapter 61: Pītha Pañcaka Lakṣaṇam (The Illustration of five Pedestals)

## Overview
This chapter details the foundational guidelines for the Dravida Prāsādas (mansions/temples) which can range from single-storeyed structures up to twelve storeys. It primarily establishes the five types of pedestals (Pīṭhas) and the five Talacchandas (ground plans).

## The Five Pedestals (Pīṭhas)
1. **Pāda-bandhana:** The first pedestal. It has an elevation divided into 20 parts. Includes a Khuraka (5 parts), Padmapattrikā (2 parts), Kaṇikā (1 part), Kumuda (3 parts), Kaṇṭha/dado (1 part), and Paṭṭikā (1 part).
2. **Śrī-bandha:** The second pedestal. Its measurement is divided into 27 folds. Features a 2-part Padmapattrikā, 3-part Kumuda, and specific dimensions for the Makara and Makarapaṭṭikā.
3. **Vedī-bandhana:** The third pedestal. Elevation is divided by 19 parts. Incorporates a Nīdavartti of 4 parts and a Kumuda of 3 parts.
4. **Pratikrama:** The fourth pedestal, noted for its excellent structure.
5. **Kṣuraka-bandhana:** The fifth pedestal. The elevation is divided into 20 parts. Features a Nīravartti (4 parts), Padmapattrikā, Kaṇikā (1 part), and a 3-part Kapota with a nāsikā.

*Note: Above these pedestals is the Khuravaraṇḍikā.*

## The Five Talacchandas (Ground Plans)
1. **Padma:** Features a square-shaped field where the Karṇa Sūtra is stretched. Includes a Sūkarānana (hog-faced design) water course.
2. **Mahāpadma:** Adored by kings. Elaborates on the meeting points (saṃpātas) across various directional quarters (Aindra, Āgneyya, Nairṛta, Yāmya).
3. **Vardhamāna:** A square plot divided into 15 segments. Features a Kūṭa (2 parts), Pañjara (1.5 parts), and Śālā.
4. **Svastika:** Divides a square field into 28 parts. Highly fascinating plan where walls are made of specific parts and features a Candraśālā (Moon chamber).
5. **Sarvatobhadra:** Divides the plot by 28. Features an octagonal Śālā and Kūṭas of part-triads.

These layouts can be built as *Nirandhāra* (without closed balconies) or *Sāndhāra* (with closed balconies/verandahs).

# Chapter 62: The Definition of Dravida Prāsādas

## Overview
This chapter provides the vertical measurements (elevations) and architectural elements for Dravida Prāsādas, scaling from a single-storeyed structure up to twelve storeys. Measurements are largely established using the *Karṇamāna* (measurement of the Karṇa).

## Storey Specifications

### Single-Storeyed (Ekabhūmika)
* **Dimensions:** Breadth of 5 cubits, height of 7 cubits.
* **Key Elements:** Pāda of 2 cubits (decorated), Mālā (2 levels), Laśunaka, Bharaṇa, Kalaśādyuttara, Hīraka, and Vasanta.
* **Roof/Top:** A Kapota with a nāsikā (3 layers) and a Kalaśa equipped with Nāsikā Padma.

### Two-Storeyed (Dvibhūmika)
* **Dimensions:** Breadth of 7 cubits, height of 7 cubits.
* **Key Elements:** The Kūṭa is established as two-parted. Features a second Jaṅghā (1 part), a Vedikā with a Kaṇṭha, and a Ghaṇṭā elevated by 1.5 parts.

### Three-Storeyed (Tribhūmika)
* **Dimensions:** Breadth of 11 cubits, height of 15 cubits.
* **Key Elements:** Pīṭha of 2 cubits, first Jaṅghā of 2 parts, second Jaṅghā of 9 layers, and a third Jaṅghā elevated by 1.5 parts. Includes an 11-layered Kumbha.

### Four to Twelve Storeys
* **Four-Storeyed:** Breadth 15 cubits, height 21 padas. Features huge columns on the fourth storey.
* **Five-Storeyed:** Breadth 21 cubits, height 29.75 cubits (30 reduced by a quarter). Includes a Mahāghaṇṭā of 4 parts and a 19-layered Kumbha.
* **Six-Storeyed:** Breadth 30 cubits, height 40 cubits.
* **Seven-Storeyed:** Breadth 35 cubits, height 49.5 cubits.
* **Eight-Storeyed:** Breadth 40 cubits, height 56.75 cubits (57 minus 3 digits).
* **Nine-Storeyed:** Breadth 51 cubits, height 72 cubits.
* **Ten-Storeyed:** Breadth 56.25 cubits, height 79 cubits.
* **Eleven-Storeyed:** Breadth 65 cubits, height 92 cubits.
* **Twelve-Storeyed:** Breadth 67 cubits, height 95 cubits. Features an intricately decorated 4-cubit Ghaṇṭā and Skandha.

The chapter concludes by affirming that the *Padma, Mahāpadma, Svastika, Vardhamānaka*, and *Sarvatobhadra* plans can be adapted to any of these multi-storey configurations.

# Chapter 63: Meru and others (Viṃśikā Nāgara Prāsādas)

## Overview
This chapter describes the twenty types of *Nāgara Prāsādas* (town buildings/temples). These are typically highly decorated, multi-peaked structures designed to specific storeys and architectural metaphors.

## The Twenty Nāgara Prāsādas
1. **Meru:** The chief Prāsāda. 16 floors, 4 gates, highly variegated peaks. The plumb line marks 50 cubits. Has Andhārikā (balconies) of 6 cubits all around.
2. **Mandara:** 12 storeys, 40 cubits.
3. **Kailāsa:** 9 storeys, beautifully built.
4. **Kumbha:** 9 storeys. Ewer-shaped, stationed like folded hands, decorated by 5 Aṇḍakas (spires).
5. **Mṛgarāja:** Decorated by Moon chambers (Candraśālās) and huge entrance halls.
6. **Gaja:** Tusker-shaped, features many Candraśālās.
7. **Vimānacchanda:** 8 storeys, many peaked, highly elevated.
8. **Nandivardhana:** 7 storeys, 20 Aṇḍakas, 32 cubits in extent.
9. **Nandana:** 6 storeys, 16 Aṇḍakas, 30 cubits in extent.
10. **Sarvatobhadra/Sarvatodaka:** 5 storeys, decorated by Bhadraśālās.
11. **Vṛṣa (Vāvṛkṣa):** Equal in extent to its elevation, square-shaped, 5 Aṇḍakas.
12. **Siṃha (Siṃhāsya):** Lion-shaped.
13. **Vartula (Maṇḍala):** Circular/globular, decorated by 1 Aṇḍaka.
14. **Samudraka:** 16-angled on all sides, 2 storeys, flanked by Moon chambers.
15. **Garuḍa (Garutmad):** 7 storeys (or an alternate 10-storey version), 6 angles (hexagonal).
16. **Padmaka:** 16-angled, 3 storeys.
17. **Śuddhapuṣpaka:** A detailed vimāna dividing a square plot into 25 segments. Features a 5-digit Rathikā, 3-part Pañjara, and a Vedīkābandha.
*(Other variations include Hamsa, Nandāvartta, etc., rounding out the twenty).*

## Material & Construction
These prāsādas are to be equipped with entrance halls (Prāggrīva) and arched portals (Toraṇa). They can be built using bricks (aiṣṭikā), wood (dāravā), or stone (śailajā).
